slots.name: death toll
slots.sentence: An avalanche on Pakistan's Broad Peak has killed famed climber Nirmal Purja and the nine other members of a mountaineering expedition who were trying to reach one of the highest peaks on Earth.

slots.name: confirmed death toll
slots.sentence: Elite Exped said in its post that other climbers had died, naming “his trusted climbing partners and guides, Pur Bahadur Gurung (Yukta) and Nima Sherpa,” and at least three other climbers had been confirmed dead as of Saturday afternoon local time.
